# An external merge during readiness polling must synchronize trunk and allow
# the next change to merge, even when the readiness command keeps waiting.
# https://github.com/abhinav/git-spice/issues/1357

as 'Test <test@example.com>'
at '2026-10-26T03:42:44Z'

cd repo
git init
git config spice.experiment.merge true
git commit --allow-empty -m 'Initial commit'
shamhub-setup
shamhub new origin alice/example.git
shamhub register alice
git push origin main
env SHAMHUB_USERNAME=alice
gs auth login

git add feature1.txt
gs branch create feature1 -m 'Add feature 1'
git add feature2.txt
gs branch create feature2 -m 'Add feature 2'
gs stack submit --fill
stderr 'Created #1'
stderr 'Created #2'

# The readiness command merges #1 externally on its first invocation, after
# preflight has selected both changes. It never reports #1 ready afterward.
chmod 755 $WORK/ready-command.sh
git config spice.merge.ready.command $WORK/ready-command.sh
gs stack merge --ready-timeout=11s --no-prompt
stderr 'external merge completed'
stderr 'feature1: waiting for merge readiness'
! stderr 'feature1: merging #1:'
stderr 'feature2: merging #2:'
stderr 'All 2 change.s. merged.'

# Both commits reach local trunk through the normal synchronization barrier.
git show main:feature1.txt
stdout 'feature 1'
git show main:feature2.txt
stdout 'feature 2'

-- repo/feature1.txt --
feature 1
-- repo/feature2.txt --
feature 2
-- ready-command.sh --
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

if [ "$GIT_SPICE_BRANCH" != feature1 ]; then
  exit 0
fi
if [ ! -f "$WORK/external-merge-completed" ]; then
  curl -fsS -X POST \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -H "Authentication-Token: $GIT_SPICE_SHAMHUB_TOKEN" \
    -d '{}' \
    "$GIT_SPICE_SHAMHUB_API_URL/alice/example/change/1/merge"
  touch "$WORK/external-merge-completed"
  echo external merge completed
fi
exit 1
